Beyond the Best Buy 60th anniversary deals, this week's discounts on AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off, AirPods Max 2 down $120 across all five colors, and AirTag 2 back to historical lows are still going strong — but today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break has plenty more new offers worth noting. If you act fast, Apple's official refurbished store just restocked, with the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro down to $1,099, available in Midnight Black, Starlight, and Sky Blue. We also found multiple brand-new M5 Pro MacBook Pro models down $400. The $100 discount on Apple Watch Series 11 is back as well, starting at just over $250. We've also got Twelve South accessory deals — including its Find My charger and the Curve Nano MagSafe stand — both at new Amazon lows. All the deals are listed below.

AirPods discounts dip further with up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 down 25% and more

After an entire summer of consistent discounts on Apple's latest AirPods lineup, prices on nearly every model have dropped further. The ever-popular AirPods Pro 3 are now 25% off, one of the lowest prices ever. The ANC-equipped AirPods 4 have also fallen to their lowest price in months, while the AirPods Max 2 are down another $120 this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)

AirTag 2 back to historical low, starting at $22 (4-pack and single)

  • AirTag 2 $24 (originally $29) | Amazon
  • AirTag 2 $24 (originally $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 "Excellent" open-box $20 (originally $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (originally $99)

Best Buy anniversary one-day LG deals: TVs from $330, 2026 OLED models down $600 and more

Restock alert: Cheapest M5 MacBook Air back to $1,099 at Apple Refurbished — act fast (brand-new models down $200)

Update 8/20: This deal has restocked back at $1,099, available in Midnight Black, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This deal will very likely end soon — they always do — but Apple's official refurbished store just restocked the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro down to $1,099 with free shipping, in Midnight Black, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

Every time Apple restocks this configuration, it sells out fast, so if you're interested, don't miss out — after all, this is the lowest price we've seen for an M5 MacBook Air.

Apple's official certified refurbished store is now selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air for $1,099, equipped with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage, with free shipping. As mentioned above, as of writing, Midnight Black, Starlight, and Sky Blue are still in stock.

The original price is $1,299, and it's currently $200 cheaper than the brand-new model.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299)
  • Midnight Black, Starlight, and Sky Blue

As a reminder, all products from Apple's official refurbished store come with the following guarantees:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare available for purchase
  • Sold only after passing Apple's rigorous refurbishment process

For comparison, the same brand-new model on Amazon is priced very close to the $1,299 official retail price, with the silver version down to $1,240.

Amazon still has multiple M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations down $400

Yesterday as part of its 60th anniversary celebration, Best Buy launched a one-day-only Apple promotion, highlighted by $400 off two M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations — but if you missed it, Amazon still has the same two deals today.

Amazon is still selling these two 14-inch 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro models at $400 below official retail — one with base CPU/GPU specs and the other upgraded to an 18-core CPU with a 12-core configuration.

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (originally $2,999) 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,799 (originally $3,199) 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

These are indeed the same deals we recommended yesterday, though at the time it seemed they would only last a day — Best Buy did say so, and there's no telling whether Amazon will follow suit. Overall, Amazon could end these deals at any moment, but as of writing they're still live, and we want to make sure you're in the know.

This 48GB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is down $400 today

B&H is now selling the Apple 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro for $2,699 with free shipping, equipped with 48GB of RAM and 1TB of storage.

This $3,099 configuration is $400 cheaper than buying directly from Apple.

Apple Watch Series 11 anniversary deals down $100, Best Buy open-box from $254

Although yesterday's 24-hour 60th anniversary limited Apple deals have ended, there are still plenty of great offers. Beyond AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off, AirPods Max 2 down $120, and the latest AirTag 2 back at historical lows, we've also found every cheapest Apple Watch Series 11 model on Amazon and Best Buy down $100 — and you can find "Excellent" open-box units as low as $254.

Amazon is again selling all base 46mm Series 11 models for $329 with free shipping, $100 below the $429 official price, with all four case colors available at this discounted price.

However, the smaller and cheaper 42mm version is now nearly sold out. That's where Best Buy can help.

Best Buy is running a week-long 60th anniversary celebration, with all 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 models in stock, priced $100 below official retail.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

Although the price difference isn't huge, I want to point out the "Excellent" open-box deal on the Jet Black 42mm model — you can snag one for $253.99 with free shipping, $145 below the official retail price for a brand-new unit. It's only $45 cheaper than buying a brand-new model right now, but $45 isn't small change, and this is the lowest price we can find from a reputable retailer.

Amazon's top-tier Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models down $220 today (matching Prime Day pricing)

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (originally $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (originally $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (originally $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (originally $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (originally $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (originally $1,299)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple Refurbished Store feature, you can pick up a fully functional iPhone 16 starting at $699 with a one-year Apple warranty, while the 1TB 16 Pro Max is priced at $1,269 — $330 cheaper than the equivalent 17 Pro Max and $130 cheaper than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 cheaper than the 17 series)

The Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the most beautiful MagSafe stands I've seen, from $27 (originally $35)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Twelve South PowerCord multi-functional braided USB-C charger now down to $16.50 (45% off)
  • 5TB for just $180? Rare deal drops WD Elements external hard drive to lowest price since storage prices rose (today only)
  • Woot latest deals: Keychron mechanical keyboards from $20, up to 64% off
  • This 14-in-1 Anker Prime docking station is down $100, a new low
  • This Anker 8-outlet USB surge protector is $22 today
  • Upgrade your home theater with the Govee TV Backlight 3 Lite kit for responsive lighting, from $110, more models from $60
  • Petcube Cam 360 offers 360-degree pet monitoring and two-way talk, just $35
  • Govee's latest Floor Lamp 3 Lite supports Matter, from $85, or up to 47% off other models, from $80
  • Anker Nano 100W 3-port charger with 5ft cable, $36 today

Amazon now has AirPods Max 2 down $120 across all five colors (one of the best prices ever)

This week's 60th anniversary celebration has brought one of the best prices ever for the Apple 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon now offering all five colors at a $120 discount.

Amazon is now selling the Apple AirPods Max 2 for $429 with free shipping.

At $120 off the previous generation's same price of $549, this is the lowest brand-new price we can currently find from a reputable retailer.

Best Buy does have a Midnight Black "Excellent" open-box unit for $403.99 with free shipping, which is cheaper, but it may not be cheap enough to make you pass up a brand-new unit.

Apple launched a genuine next-generation AirPods Max this year, not just a new color version with a USB-C port. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, the over-ear model won't be updated at next month's launch event, so this week we can pick one up with a $120 discount — and in the short term, it's very likely to remain Apple's newest and best over-ear headphones.

Only one promotion has ever offered a lower price — this summer's Prime Day, when the price was $30 lower than today's deal — and that 4-day promotion had quite limited and unsteady inventory.

Anker 45W Nano smart display charger holds at $26 low, but this bundle is just $4 more and includes a USB-C cable

As part of the ongoing 60th anniversary celebration, Best Buy is selling the white Anker 45W Nano smart display charger for $29.99 with free shipping, and it includes a Nano USB-C cable. That's only about $4 more than the charger's current $25.99 sale price with free shipping at Amazon and Best Buy. Considering the included Nano USB-C cable typically retails for around $18, you're essentially paying just $4 more to add the cable — a very worthwhile option. More details below.

  • Anker Nano 45W GaN Smart Display Charger $25.99 (originally $40)
  • Black
  • Blue
  • Orange
  • White

The Anker 45W Nano charger features a built-in smart display that identifies supported devices (such as iPhone and iPad Pro models) and automatically adjusts power delivery. The screen also shows real-time charging info and animations, so you can see the charging status as soon as you plug in a device. It comes with a top-mounted USB-C port delivering up to 45W output, plus prongs that fold 180 degrees, making it very convenient for both everyday use and travel. Anker offers four colors, including an orange that matches Apple's Cosmic Orange devices. This special offer includes an Anker Nano USB-C cable for just $4 more. This braided cable supports up to 240W charging and 480Mb/s data transfer, making it a solid choice overall — if you're looking for a new reliable phone charging cable, this is definitely a good option.

Other Anker deals worth noting

  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 MagSafe foldable charger $100 (originally $150)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 charging stand with display $135 (originally $230)
  • Anker 160W 3-port Prime charger with display and touch controls $116 (originally $150)
